# Insights (generated by `kb index`; the always-on list, edit the domain files instead)

Each line is a thinking-process correction distilled from logged incidents. Weight = how many
incidents backed it (ExpeL scoring: new = 2, +1 per confirmation, -1 per contradiction, retired at 0).
Read the full entry (correction, faulty pattern, evidence) in the domain file when it applies to your task.

- I-0001 (w2; assumption,verification) A remembered or inferred fact is a hypothesis until observed this session → insights/core.md#i-0001
- I-0002 (w2; testing,verification) Different checks are different claims → insights/testing.md#i-0002
- I-0003 (w2; process,coordination,assumption) Report the state of what you can observe, never a proxy for it → insights/process.md#i-0003
- I-0004 (w2; safety,verification) Re-derive the target of an irreversible step from current state, not from the plan → insights/core.md#i-0004
- I-0005 (w2; communication,scope) An answer to one question is not approval of the whole plan → insights/communication.md#i-0005
- I-0006 (w2; research,data,communication) A number without its convention is not a number → insights/research.md#i-0006
